subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should this PR change the unset QMD embed timeout default from 120s to 600s without live QMD/GGUF proof, or should maintainers require proof or a narrower default strategy first?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes upgrade behavior and derived lock waits for all existing unset QMD semantic users, while the contributor explicitly could not prove the real GGUF runtime path.

options.title: Require proof or override
options.body: Require redacted live QMD/GGUF embed output under the unset 600s default, or record an explicit maintainer proof/default-risk override before merge.

options.title: Accept broad default
options.body: Merge after maintainers intentionally accept longer embed and lock waits for all unset QMD semantic users and align the docs.

options.title: Narrow the strategy
options.body: Ask for a selective local-GGUF/default-detection approach or warning/docs-only change if the broad default is too risky.

recommendation.title: Require proof or override
recommendation.body: Require redacted live QMD/GGUF embed output under the unset 600s default, or record an explicit maintainer proof/default-risk override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee and has recent QMD config history on the same backend config/schema surface.
